description:
Beispiel: „Wo steht die Rauch Fruchtsäfte GmbH im Vergleich zu gleich großen Firmen?“

Benchmark ONE company against its size-class cohort: headline metrics, percentile
        ranks and the nearest peers. Read-only.

        Parameters:
        - company_id (required): "AT:{fnr}" (bare FNR accepted). Austria only (needs parsed
          financials); a German id returns a clear error.
        - n (optional, default 10): how many nearest peers to return.

        Returns the AT backend's benchmark payload plus ``country`` and the prefixed
        ``company_id``: headline figures, ``percentiles`` within the UGB size class, and the
        nearest peers with a recency note. For a cross-border meaning-based peer set use
        find_peers with cross_border=true.
name: benchmark_company
title: Benchmark a company vs peers (AT)
